props.label: Our store
props.heading: Silver and gold, for pooja, festivals and gifting
props.body:
At Bafna Jewellers you will find silver idols and murtis in every size — murti, casting and paper casting — along with silver pooja articles such as samai, kalash, lota and plates, and pieces for gifting.

For gold, we carry traditional Kolhapuri jewellery: thushi, mani, bormala, fancy malas, tops and Kolhapuri saaj. Many designs can be made to order in your size or colour.

Prices change with the day's gold and silver rate, so every product page has a WhatsApp button — send it and we will reply with the price, weight and availability.
